title: Vicarious Pain: Why You Wince at Fails
caption:
You're laughing, then a fail hits and you WINCE. Why?
A cartoon guy giggles through a fail compilation, then clutches his chest in agony as a skater bails, and ends up in a full bubble suit.
That's vicarious pain: mirror neurons make your brain's pain matrix automatically simulate the injury you're watching.
Which fail clip made you wince the hardest? Drop it below.
Share this with the friend who yelps at every skateboard fail.
